lead: Each card has a pin, the city as its heading, the address and a directions link. One to twelve cards, two to four per row.
note: Each directions link names its destination. Twelve links all called 'Directions' would sound the same to a screen reader user.

items.title: The title is the city
items.text:
The text holds the address
and keeps its line breaks
so it can be copied

items.title: Each card is an address element
items.text:
Street and number
Postcode and town
Phone

items.title: Cards of equal height
items.text:
Each card stretches to the tallest
in its row, so the pins
line up
